source.name: Tanzil Quran metadata (classification and revelation order)

period.heading: Period of Revelation
period.text: It appears from the tone of the Surah that it belongs to that group of the Surahs which were revealed during the last stage of the Makkan period.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)

theme.heading: Central Theme and Purpose
theme.text: This Surah is an admonition and a warning to the disbelievers who were rejecting the Message of the Holy Prophet and devising cunning schemes to defeat his Mission. But warning, reproof, censure and reproach dominate admonition.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)
